# Peptide Plainly

> Friendly, plain-English explanations of peptide research, plus a free newsletter every Friday. Every claim links to PubMed or official FDA/WADA sources. Education only, not medical advice. We never give doses for research-only peptides; for FDA-approved drugs we summarize the official label and note that the prescriber sets the dose.

## Featured: the GLP-1 weight-loss guides
Our most popular guides. Retatrutide is the hottest one right now.
- [GLP-1s: semaglutide vs tirzepatide vs retatrutide vs orforglipron](https://peptideplainly.com/glp1-comparison.html): Semaglutide, tirzepatide, retatrutide and orforglipron side by side: weight-loss results, pills vs shots, receptors and FDA status.
- [What is semaglutide? Ozempic & Wegovy results, dosing](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/semaglutide.html): FDA-approved. What is semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy, Rybelsus)? How it works, STEP 1 and SELECT results, FDA label dosing, side effects and FAQs.
- [What is tirzepatide? Mounjaro & Zepbound results, dosing](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/tirzepatide.html): FDA-approved. What is tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound)? How it works, how it beat semaglutide in SURMOUNT-5, FDA label dosing, side effects and FAQs.
- [What is retatrutide? Results, side effects & status](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/retatrutide.html): Investigational: not approved; only available in Lilly clinical trials. What is retatrutide? Lilly's triple-agonist shot hit up to −25% average weight change in TRIUMPH-1. Results, side effects, FDA status and FAQs.
- [What is orforglipron (Foundayo)? The GLP-1 pill explained](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/orforglipron.html): FDA-approved. What is orforglipron (Foundayo)? Lilly's FDA-approved daily GLP-1 pill: how it works, ATTAIN-1 results, label dosing, side effects and FAQs.

## Peptide guides (why people are excited, quick facts, dosing & timing, evidence, FAQ)
- [Semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy): the GLP-1 that started the weight-loss revolution](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/semaglutide.html): FDA-approved. What is semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy, Rybelsus)? How it works, STEP 1 and SELECT results, FDA label dosing, side effects and FAQs.
- [Tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound): the shot that beat semaglutide head-to-head](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/tirzepatide.html): FDA-approved. What is tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound)? How it works, how it beat semaglutide in SURMOUNT-5, FDA label dosing, side effects and FAQs.
- [Retatrutide: record-breaking Phase 3 results & what's next](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/retatrutide.html): Investigational: not approved; only available in Lilly clinical trials. What is retatrutide? Lilly's triple-agonist shot hit up to −25% average weight change in TRIUMPH-1. Results, side effects, FDA status and FAQs.
- [Orforglipron (Foundayo): the no-needle GLP-1 pill, results & how to take it](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/orforglipron.html): FDA-approved. What is orforglipron (Foundayo)? Lilly's FDA-approved daily GLP-1 pill: how it works, ATTAIN-1 results, label dosing, side effects and FAQs.
- [BPC-157: the cult recovery peptide, and what the research shows](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/bpc-157.html): Research purposes only. What is BPC-157? The plain-English guide to the popular recovery peptide: what the research shows, status, and FAQs.
- [TB-500 (thymosin beta-4): the repair peptide athletes swear by](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/tb-500.html): Research purposes only. What is TB-500? The plain-English guide to thymosin beta-4 and TB-500: what it is, the research, status, and FAQs.
- [GHK-Cu: the copper peptide behind glowing-skin routines](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/ghk-cu.html): Research purposes only (injectable). What is GHK-Cu, the copper peptide? Skincare benefits, what the research shows, status, and FAQs.
- [Collagen peptides: the skin supplement with 26 trials behind it](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/collagen-peptides.html): Dietary supplement. Do collagen peptides work? What meta-analyses of 26 trials show for skin hydration, elasticity and wrinkles, plus FAQs.
- [Tesamorelin (Egrifta): the GH-boosting peptide that cut deep belly fat in trials](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/tesamorelin.html): FDA-approved (as Egrifta). What is tesamorelin (Egrifta)? Plain-English guide: how it cuts deep belly fat, FDA label dosing, the trial, and FAQs.
- [CJC-1295 & ipamorelin: the famous GH stack, and what studies show](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/cjc-1295-ipamorelin.html): Research purposes only. CJC-1295 and ipamorelin explained plainly: the popular GH stack, what studies found, status, and FAQs.
- [MOTS-c: the 'exercise in a vial' mitochondrial peptide](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/mots-c.html): Research purposes only. What is MOTS-c? Plain-English guide to the 'exercise in a vial' mitochondrial peptide: the research, status, and FAQs.
- [Semax: the nasal brain peptide that raised BDNF in a clinical study](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/semax.html): Research purposes only. What is Semax? Plain-English guide to the nasal brain peptide: the research on BDNF and stroke recovery, status, and FAQs.
- [PT-141 (bremelanotide): the desire drug that works on the brain, not blood flow](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/pt-141.html): FDA-approved (as Vyleesi). What is PT-141 (bremelanotide, Vyleesi)? FDA label use and dosing, trial results, side effects, and how 'research PT-141' differs.
- [Melanotan II (MT2): the viral tan jab, and what studies really show](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/melanotan-2.html): Research purposes only. What is Melanotan II (MT2)? The 'tan jab' peptide behind the TikTok buzz: the tanning and libido studies, appetite research, risks and status.
- [Epitalon: the telomere peptide behind the longevity buzz](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/epitalon.html): Research purposes only. What is Epitalon? The longevity peptide behind the telomere buzz: the cell, mouse and small human studies, FDA status and FAQs.
- [Selank: the calm-and-focus nasal peptide everyone's talking about](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/selank.html): Research purposes only. What is Selank? The calming nasal peptide from Russia: the anxiety studies, animal research on memory and stress, status and FAQs.
- [KPV: the 3-amino-acid peptide taking on gut inflammation](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/kpv.html): Research purposes only. What is KPV? The anti-inflammatory tripeptide fans use for gut and skin: the colitis and cell studies, FDA status and FAQs.
- [Kisspeptin: the hormone that lit up desire circuits in trials](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/kisspeptin.html): Research purposes only. What is kisspeptin? The hormone peptide behind the libido buzz: randomized brain-scan trials in men and women, FDA status and FAQs.
- [CagriSema: the amylin + semaglutide shot behind −20.4% in Phase 3](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/cagrilintide.html): Investigational: not FDA-approved. What is cagrilintide (CagriSema)? Novo's amylin + semaglutide shot: −20.4% in REDEFINE 1, side effects, FDA status and FAQs.
- [SS-31 (elamipretide): the mitochondria peptide that won FDA approval](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/elamipretide.html): FDA-approved (as Forzinity). What is SS-31 (elamipretide)? The mitochondria peptide, now FDA-approved as Forzinity: label use, dosing, the aging-mouse data and FAQs.
- [BPC-157 + TB-500: the Wolverine stack, put to the test](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/bpc-157-tb-500-stack.html): Research purposes only. BPC-157 + TB-500, the 'Wolverine stack': what each peptide's research shows, the first study testing them together, status and risks.

## Tools & buyer guides
- [Retatrutide side effects: what 13,589 users reported online](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/retatrutide-side-effects.html): Penn's JAMA Network Open study (Oct 14, 2026) of self-reported symptoms in Reddit posts. Research purposes only.
- [Peptide reconstitution calculator](https://peptideplainly.com/peptide-reconstitution-calculator.html): Math-only peptide calculator: vial mg + water mL + your amount in mcg or mg gives concentration, mL and U-100 syringe units. No presets, no dose suggestions.
- [How to check a peptide lab report (COA)](https://peptideplainly.com/how-to-tell-if-a-peptide-source-is-legit.html): COA checklist (lot match, HPLC purity, mass spec identity, endotoxin), verifying the lab, FDA lookup tools and red flags.
- [Semaglutide vs tirzepatide vs retatrutide: the numbers](https://peptideplainly.com/semaglutide-vs-tirzepatide.html): SURMOUNT-5 head-to-head (−20.2% vs −13.7% at 72 weeks), STEP 1 and SURMOUNT-1, plus retatrutide's published phase 2, TRIUMPH-1 and TRIUMPH-2 results (not head-to-head; retatrutide is investigational).
- [Retatrutide release date & FDA approval status](https://peptideplainly.com/peptides/retatrutide-fda-approval-status.html): Not FDA-approved. Lilly plans to submit in Q1 2027. TRIUMPH phase 3 timeline and the biologic classification dispute.
- [Compounded or brand-name semaglutide & tirzepatide? How to tell](https://peptideplainly.com/compounded-vs-brand-semaglutide-tirzepatide.html): Beginner guide: label and packaging checks (pens vs vials), NDC lookup, 503A vs 503B, and what the FDA says about compounded GLP-1s.
- [FDA-approved peptides list](https://peptideplainly.com/fda-approved-peptides-list.html): Which peptides are FDA-approved (semaglutide, tirzepatide, tesamorelin, bremelanotide, elamipretide, oxytocin, hCG...), which can be compounded, and which are research-only (BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu...), with FDA sources.
- [NSW peptide ER surge](https://peptideplainly.com/nsw-peptide-emergency-department-surge.html): NSW Health surveillance: 1,180 ED presentations mentioning unapproved peptides (Jul 2025–Sep 2026), retatrutide in 833, with caveats and sources.
- [BPC-157 and the HHS peptide policy](https://peptideplainly.com/bpc-157-compounding-fda-interim-policy.html): HHS's 503A peptide enforcement-discretion policy (FR doc 2026-22192, docket HHS-OASH-2026-0496): cleared OIRA Oct 27, published Oct 30, 2026 (91 FR 68526); covers BPC-157, epitalon, KPV, MOTS-c, semax, TB-500 (Appendix A); comments close Nov 13, 2026; who it covers, what it doesn't do.
- [Peptide FDA status tracker](https://peptideplainly.com/peptide-fda-status-tracker.html): Status by compound with latest FDA event, source and last-checked date, plus a dated What-changed log (approvals, PCAC votes, RIN 0910-ZD94).
- [Peptide recalls and FDA warning letters](https://peptideplainly.com/peptide-recalls-and-fda-warning-letters.html): FDA warning letters to online peptide sellers, quoted exactly with fda.gov links; recalls section lists only fda.gov-verified items.
